flow: How a connection reaches its destination

scenarios.extend: Add an entry to an existing core

node.title: Connect the service that runs Xray
node.body: For a local service, continue to the next step. For a remote server, install a compatible node panel and create an API token in its security settings. Add the node on the controller with its panel address, port, web base path and token. Test the connection, save and wait for the node to come online. Remote outbound and routing changes require a node-admin token.

inbound.title: Create the first inbound
inbound.body: Add an inbound, select the protocol and choose the node under Deploy to, or retain the local service. Set a remark, an available listening port and the transport and security settings expected by clients. Save, check that the inbound is enabled and verify the port is reachable.

forward.title: Check the forwarding path
forward.body: Select the same service under Outbounds and check the destination outbound. For default forwarding, verify the default outbound. For a dedicated path, match the inbound tag to the outbound in Routing, check rule order and save.

host.title: Publish a reachable endpoint
host.body: Add a subscription host, select the inbound and enter a domain or IP address reachable by users. Override the port if the public port differs from the listener. Verify DNS, forwarding and TLS settings.

enable.title: Enable the subscription service
enable.body: Open the subscription settings, enable the service and save. When publishing through a reverse proxy, set the reverse proxy URI to the public subscription base URL, including its path and trailing slash.

client.title: Create the client and grant access
client.body: Add a client with a unique identifier, select the permitted inbounds, set the quota and expiry, and check that a subscription ID has been generated before saving. Create a separate client for each user who needs independent credentials and quota.

deliver.title: Deliver and test the subscription
deliver.body: Copy the subscription URL from the client’s QR code dialog. Import and refresh it in the client application. Check the entry name, address and port, connect through the new entry, then check the client’s traffic counters. For a portal account, follow Portal plan subscription to collect the link.

reuse.title: Locate the existing Xray service
reuse.body: Verify the target node is online, or use the local service for a core on the controller. A panel-managed core can accept another inbound. A standalone Xray process first needs a compatible managing panel. Use that panel’s API address for the node connection.

listener.title: Add a listener for a new port or protocol
listener.body: Add an inbound on the same service with an available port and the desired protocol and transport. Keep existing listeners and their ports. To publish another public address for an existing listener, continue to the next step.

alias.title: Associate the public address with an inbound
alias.body: Add a subscription host. Select the new inbound for a new listener, or the original inbound for a domain alias or forwarded address. Enter the public address and port and verify they reach that listener.

attach.title: Update an existing subscription
attach.body: Edit the existing client and add the new inbound alongside its current grants. For another address on the same inbound, check that the client or plan grants the new host. Keep the subscription ID and refresh the original URL. For independent credentials, select Issue a subscription.

plan.title: Enable the portal and configure a plan
plan.body: Under Portal and commerce, enable the portal and check its public subscription URL. Open Choose entries in the plan editor. Select an inbound to see its entries and how each is granted. You can grant individual entries or include all current and future entries on the inbound. Confirm the selection, then save the plan.

account.title: Activate the plan for an account
account.body: Under Accounts, create an account with a gifted plan, or let a registered user purchase the plan. Check the active plan in the account details and open its linked client to verify the granted inbounds.

portal.title: Collect the link in the portal
portal.body: Sign in to the customer portal, open Subscription link and generate a link. Import it in the client application, refresh and connect. Observe the expiry or single-use setting shown by the portal and request another link when needed.
